absolute_stout_ground_force_normal_delta.warning: one fixed synthetic omitted-state design only; this is screening evidence, not calibrated physical coverage

pointwise_all_cells.warning: cells within a panel share the same fit and are correlated; use panel-cluster summaries for inference

fit.absolute_force_interval: two-sided 95% normal delta interval from inverse whitened-Jacobian covariance; diagnostic and uncalibrated
fit.method: regularized full-covariance GLS; q/h/x finite-difference delta uppers and absolute-force asymptotic normal delta interval
fit.simultaneous_method: one-sided Bonferroni over 72 q/h/x terms at family alpha 0.05

generator.panel_independence: fresh independent RNG stream per panel; blocks follow the declared within-panel noise model
generator.seed_rule: numpy default_rng(2026113600 + panel_index); disjoint from prior screens
generator.truth: 2 vacuum x 3 static states; fit fixed at 2 x 2

open_gates: one omitted-state truth design only; no near-degenerate, weak-ground-overlap, vacuum-omission, finite-Nt alternates, correlated-block, or unequal-covariance grid
delta intervals condition on estimated covariance and the misspecified 2x2 model; no method selection or recalibration performed
small number of independent panels gives wide Monte Carlo intervals
production correlators, exporter convention, matched-Nt thermal/mixed receipts, force/reference uncertainty and independent review absent

report_metadata.interpretation: Checks only whether the current two-sector GLS absolute stout ground-force normal-delta interval contains the exact force in one fixed 2-vacuum x 3-static truth while fitting 2 x 2. It does not calibrate physical coverage or validate the source/exporter convention.
report_metadata.seed_rule: numpy default_rng(2026113600 + panel_index); disjoint from prior screens
